user.title: Set up WiCAN
user.description:
WiCAN devices are usually discovered automatically. Use manual setup only if automatic discovery failed.

Enter the hostname or IP address of your WiCAN device.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered WiCAN device
zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to add the WiCAN device **{name}** at `{url}` to Home Assistant?

reconfigure.title: Change the WiCAN's address
reconfigure.description: Enter where Home Assistant now reaches this WiCAN. It must answer there as the same device.

abort.cloud_not_connected: Not connected to Home Assistant Cloud.
abort.webhook_not_internet_accessible: Your Home Assistant instance needs to be accessible from the internet to receive webhook messages.
abort.wrong_device: A different WiCAN answers at this address. Add it as a new device instead.

create_entry.default:
To send events to Home Assistant, you will need to set up a webhook.

Open WiCAN and go to *Settings → Services → Automation → Webhooks*

Enable *Webhooks* and fill in the following webhook in the URL field:

`{webhook_url}`

See [the documentation]({docs_url}) for further details.

error.cannot_connect: No WiCAN answered at this address. Check that it is awake (it sleeps when the engine is off) and on the network.
error.device_mismatch: Device ID mismatch. Expected {expected}, got {actual}. The device may have been replaced or the configuration is pointing to a different device. Please delete and reconfigure this integration.
